vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: glm-master-skill
Version: 1.0.3

The glm-master-skill is a documentation-only resource that serves as a directory for the GLM ecosystem. It contains no executable code, scripts, or subprocess calls, focusing instead on providing installation instructions via 'npx clawhub' and links to official GitHub repositories (github.com/zai-org). The SKILL.md instructions are transparent and aligned with its stated purpose of guiding users to relevant sub-skills.

llm.summary: This is a documentation-only master skill that lists GLM ecosystem skills and install instructions; its declared metadata, lack of code, and instructions are internally consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill is presented as documentation-only and declares no binaries, env vars, or install steps. The SKILL.md is purely advisory (catalog, links, and example commands) and aligns with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions remain within scope: match user intent to catalog entries, recommend installing via clawhub or GitHub, and reference the ZHIPU_API_KEY used by many GLM skills. The doc does recommend running user-side commands (e.g., npx clawhub@latest install) and consulting other skills' SKILL.md files — these are expected for an installer guide but represent actions the user will take outside the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code is included in the skill (lowest installer risk). However the guide recommends using 'npx clawhub@latest', which causes the user's environment to fetch and execute remote npm code; this is normal for such workflows but is an operational security consideration the user should be aware of.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill itself declares no required environment variables. It mentions ZHIPU_API_KEY as a common credential for downstream GLM skills, which is appropriate and proportional given the ecosystem it documents.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no install or persistent components are present. The skill does not request elevated or permanent privileges and does not modify other skills' configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a read-only guide and appears coherent and low-risk. Before following its installation suggestions: (1) verify you trust the clawhub/npm package and the specific GitHub repositories it links to (npx will fetch and run remote code); (2) review each target skill's SKILL.md and repository contents before installing; (3) only provide your ZHIPU_API_KEY to official, trusted endpoints and rotate keys if you suspect misuse; (4) if you want to avoid remote execution, prefer cloning repositories and inspecting code before running installers.
